interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · morning personal care at home
interactions.description: She toilets, washes and dresses her top half on her own in the accessible bath and bedroom; her aide arrives at 8:29, checks how she slept and gets her breakfast and morning pills at the seated worktop before her stockings, shoes and the van. An illustrative composite: in another care plan the aide could start at 8:00.

interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · home from the clinic
interactions.description: The van ramp comes down at 11:40, her aide walks beside her across the drive and up the ramp, and she comes in over the flush threshold to rest on the entry bench.

interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · toileting help and transfer
interactions.description: She manages her own clothing on the raised toilet; the aide waits at the door, helps her stand with the grab bars and guards the turn to the shower seat.

interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · assisted shower
interactions.description: In the curbless roll-in shower: the aide tests the water, hands her the hand shower for her face and front, washes her back, legs and feet, checks heels and skin folds, then dries her on the seat.

interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · dressing in the bedroom
interactions.description: Clean home clothes from the wardrobe, socks and slippers, hair combed and hearing aids back in, seated in the armchair-height dressing chair.

interactions.label: Breakfast and morning pills
interactions.description: The aide reheats congee on the front-control range, sets the bowl on a non-slip mat with a built-up spoon at the 0.76 m seated worktop, opens today's morning blister from the weekly pill pack and watches her take it with water.

interactions.label: Mrs. Wong · stockings and shoes
interactions.description: At the 0.45 m entry bench the aide puts on her compression stockings and Velcro shoes and helps with her jacket before the van.

interactions.label: Housekeeping and laundry
interactions.description: While Mrs. Wong is at the specialist the aide files the new weekly pill packs, remakes the bed for two, runs the laundry, cleans the bathroom and kitchen, and clears the route from the door to the armchair for Mr. Wong.

interactions.label: Meal hand-off at the door
interactions.description: The meals driver passes the insulated lunch bag to the aide at the door and checks in with Mrs. Wong, who answers from the entry bench; anything unusual goes back to the care team.

interactions.label: Lunch set-up
interactions.description: The delivered lunch heated in the counter-height microwave, plated and cut up at the table with a built-up spoon and a full water glass, plus the midday blister if one is prescribed; then the aide logs the visit.

interactions.label: OT home-safety check and grab bar
interactions.description: The OT checks bar heights and watches dry-run toilet and shower transfers, the installer fits a swing-up bar and Mr. Wong's bed handle, and the OT checks his side of the bed and the ramp before he comes home.

interactions.label: Ramp check
interactions.description: On the front ramp with a digital level: 0.35 m over 6.5 m is 1:18.6, gentler than the 1:12 maximum; rails on both sides, a level 2.6 m landing and a flush threshold at the door.

interactions.label: Swing-up grab bar fitted
interactions.description: On the open side of the toilet the installer fits a swing-up grab bar into the blocking at the height the OT marked (top at 34 in, rated 250 lb) for Mr. Wong's wheelchair transfers.

interactions.label: Mr. Wong · wheelchair positioning and transfer check
interactions.description: Beside his armchair, brakes on and footplates up, the nurse checks his stand-pivot technique. He stays in his wheelchair today: the armchair transfer waits for a per-segment mobility override.

interactions.label: Post-discharge home health visit
interactions.description: A home health nurse checks his vitals and pressure points and reconciles the new medicines with the weekly pill pack on the day he comes home, then goes over the warning signs and the 24/7 nurse-line number.

interactions.label: Mr. Wong · home after discharge
interactions.description: The Seen van brings him home at 3:08; the driver wheels him down the van ramp, across the drive and up the porch ramp, and he rolls himself in over the flush threshold to his armchair while Mrs. Wong welcomes him from the sofa.

interactions.label: Nurse line call · evening plan
interactions.description: 24/7 nurse line and on-call coordination: from beside his armchair on speakerphone, the nurse confirms tonight's medicines and the re-packed blister with Mr. and Mrs. Wong, reminds them when to call, and confirms tomorrow's aide visit.

actors.label: Day center music and choir leader

interactions.label: Partner center · arrival and coffee at the long tables
interactions.description: Participants settle in at the long banquet tables with coffee and tea; the activities lead welcomes everyone at the hall doors and the aide pours.

interactions.label: Partner center · calligraphy
interactions.description: Brush calligraphy at the felt-laid tables in the studio: the activity aide demonstrates strokes and seven participants practise characters on rice paper.

interactions.label: Partner center · class
interactions.description: A morning class at the whiteboard (healthy living and fall prevention): the activities lead teaches seven participants, one at the wheelchair place.

interactions.label: Partner center · group therapy
interactions.description: A support group in the circle of armchairs, led by the social worker: six participants, one at the wheelchair place in the circle.

interactions.label: Partner center · painting
interactions.description: Four of the calligraphers stay on to paint watercolour landscapes at the studio easels, with tips from the activity aide.

interactions.label: Partner center · line dance
interactions.description: Fourteen participants line-dance in three rows on the patterned dance floor, the activities lead calling the steps and the music leader playing from the stage; the others clap along from the long tables.

interactions.label: Visiting Seen PT · strength & balance
interactions.description: A Seen physical therapist visits the partner center for strength and balance with three participants who are also enrolled with Seen: walking between the parallel bars, seated strength with bands from a wheelchair, and the practice stair with the partner’s rehab aide.

interactions.label: Partner center · lunch at the long tables
interactions.description: A catered lunch at the long tables: the activities lead and the aide serve from the side aisles, then sit down to eat; three places at the table ends stay open for wheelchairs; the music leader plays.

interactions.label: Partner center · choir on the stage
interactions.description: The day center choir sings on the risers, the music leader at the piano and the activities lead conducting; the rest of the center listens and claps from the long tables.

interactions.label: Partner center · bingo
interactions.description: Bingo at the long tables: the activities lead calls from the caller’s stand beside the flashboard and eighteen participants play.

interactions.label: Partner center · afternoon studio
interactions.description: Open studio time after the choir: calligraphy at the tables and painting at the easels with the activity aide.

interactions.label: Partner center · fan dance
interactions.description: The fan dance troupe performs on the dance floor, the music leader dancing at the front; the rest of the center watches from the long tables.
